lines.text: Since its inception over 30 years ago, Super  General
has  rapidly grown into a dynamic global brand with
a presence  in  over  50  countries.  Across  all  these
markets,  Super  General  has  earned  a  reputation  for
delivering the widest range of durable home
appliances & electronics, all at exceptional value.
In the UAE, Super General has risen to become a
market leader, enjoying a dominant position across
various product categories, especially air conditioners,
a fact endorsed by independent market research.
Super General's growing reputation in the UAE cooling
industry is the result of an impressive product range
designed  and  developed  speciﬁcally  for  the  region’s
harsh climate. Even in the face of adverse weather
conditions such as high summer temperatures and
extreme humidity, Super General products are
Both commercial and residential users have come to
rely on Super General’s eﬃcacy, durability and quality,
all  backed  by  the  company’s  eﬃcient  after-sales
support.  The diverse range of air conditioners in both
residential (split, window, ﬂoor standing & portable air
VRF and rooftop package) provides solutions for all
customer needs and further underlines Super General’s
Whatever the requirements and area to be cooled,
Super General provides  the  widest range of capacities
in reciprocating & rotary compressors.  Super General’s
philosophy is  that  performance is everything when  it
comes to air conditioners. With this in mind, each and
every  Super  General  product utilizes only the ﬁnest
components  including  large  cooling  coils  and  the
highest  quality  of  copper  to deliver the best cooling
performance. This  focus  on  quality  has earned Super
General major international certiﬁcations of CB, CE,
G-mark, SASO, QSASO, ESMA, BEE and KUCAS.
Super General’s outstanding track record, consistent
growth & strong market share is a clear demonstration
that  the  company  has  raised  the  bar  within  the
appliances  &  electronics category in the UAE. Looking
ahead, the Super General mission is to not  just
maintain  the  high  standards  set, but to exceed them,
all with one aim in mind – to continuously improve the
quality of life for all our customers.
